Title: El Wak Stadium is our new home venue – Inter Allies FC URL Source: http://www http://www.interalliesfc.com/official-el-wak-stadium-is-our-new-home-venue/

### Final Answer **Team:** Inter Allies FC **League:** Ghana Premier League **Date of Announcement:** January 23, 2017 ### Supporting Information An official announcement was published on the website of the football club Inter Allies FC. The key excerpt from the announcement is: > "The Club wish to announce to the general public that we have reached an agreement with the Club Licensing Board to play our Ghana Premier League home fixtures for the 2016/17 season at the El-Wak Sports Stadium." This announcement confirms that Inter Allies FC, a participant in the Ghana Premier League, officially moved their home venue to the El Wak Stadium for the 2016/17 season. The club's Vice President, Delali Eric Senaye, stated that the decision was made primarily due to the cost and risks associated with traveling to their previous home venue in Tema. ### Methodology The conclusion was reached through the following steps: 1. **Initial Search:** A Google search was conducted for news articles published before December 2018 about a Ghanaian sports team using the El Wak Stadium as a home venue. The search query used was: `Ghanaian football club "El Wak Stadium" home venue before:2018-12-01`. 2. **Result Analysis:** The search results included a link to an official announcement on the Inter Allies FC website (interalliesfc.com) dated January 23, 2017, titled "OFFICIAL: El Wak Stadium is our new home venue." 3. **Content Extraction:** The content of the webpage was extracted to verify the details. The extracted text confirmed the team's name (Inter Allies FC), the league (Ghana Premier League), the season (2016/17), and the exact date of the announcement (January 23, 2017).
